verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no versioned API scheme and no documented deprecation policy. The only signals are a Go SDK module path ending in /v2, which is client-library packaging rather than API versioning, and an OpenAPI repo whose README says the spec may make breaking changes at any time, which cuts against a stable, versioned contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
